name: B-24 reconstruction tool register
toolEvidencePolicy: Tool capability does not increase historical evidence authority. All generated geometry remains derived until source-controlled CAD QA passes.

tools.name: img2threejs
tools.license_status: Apache-2.0 according to repository README; dependencies require separate review
tools.purpose: Generate code-only procedural Three.js visual proxies from reference images.
capabilities: detail inventory and visual quality gates
optional multi-view visual-hull carving from at least two orthographic silhouettes
tools.next_test: Use calibrated B-24J orthographic masks in an isolated proxy experiment.

tools.name: Ortho2CAD
tools.license_status: repository license and model dependencies require review before integration
tools.purpose: Translate raster orthographic drawings into editable CadQuery reconstruction candidates and STEP outputs.
capabilities: orthographic drawing generation from STEP through pythonOCC
tools.next_test: Run only after source sheets are calibrated, view-aligned and assigned to a verified B-24 variant.

sharedGates: Input files have verified provenance and SHA-256.
Units, control dimensions and view conventions are explicit.
Hidden or inferred regions retain low-confidence labels.
Tool version, parameters, prompts, seeds and parent sources are recorded.
Generated output cannot overwrite approved A-level or B-level data.
Upstream review is required before promotion into the engineering master.
